about: The old compiler's RubyMap (format 2) for a MiniGame design touching every compiled part: tiers, random debris, an added and a removed boss, actions, skill sections, skill defaults, traits with a Last stand, delayed counters and a stance, custom skills, states, unstoppable skills, maps, tilesets and boss fights.

inputs.game: RaidDesigner.Tests/GoldenCapture/MiniGame.cs (GameData built from records, no map files)
inputs.note: Keys are in the compiler's insertion order; an integer key is written as "#<n>" and a floating-point number always with a point or an exponent.

Guard.name: Guard
needsModCode: Stance Guard: when the boss uses it, add a hidden state to the boss for 2 turns (auto removal at turn end, like the game's Daystar adds state 252); while the boss has the state, the delayed counter records its triggers.

Stance Guard: the game has no delayed counter. In the counter hook (Scene_Battle#process_invoke_item, where the game rolls Game_Battler#item_counter_skill once per action and target on its first hit), roll 100% when a player's action lands a hit on the boss with any attack: an action the player chose in the command phase or a follow-up it chains into, never the party's own counters, reflection or auto and turn start skills. Record while the boss is not bound and the attacker is an opponent, as Game_Battler#enable_counter? requires, but whether or not the boss can act: hard crowd control never stops a delayed counter arming; only a seal does, of the counter skill or of every skill type of it (Game_BattlerBase#skill_sealed?, #skill_type_sealed?). Of all delayed counters that succeed on that action pick one at random, as BattleManager.auto_skill_per does, and record it with the attacker and the attacker's cell.

At the boss's next turn start, before its normal actions, queue one extra action per recorded answer with the custom skill "Blast", as the game queues its turn start skills (BattleManager.skill_interrupt: a normal action, not a forced one, so the target extension, repeats and More hits count), aimed at the attacker; if the attacker fell or left, aim it at the cell the attacker stood on.
Stance Guard answers once: its first recorded answer removes the hidden state, as Daystar's counter skill removes state 252 with <自己解除 ステート=252>.
Counter skill is the custom skill "Blast"; the mod maps the key to its runtime id.
Skill at turn end: value 2 is the custom skill "Blast"; the mod maps the key to its runtime id and writes that id into the tag.

entries.text: Last stand at 50% HP, 3 turns: Delayed counter 100%: hit by any attack → next turn Blast on the attacker; at start: Blast, clears debuffs

when state {state:1} is added, the boss uses the custom skill "Blast" at once; the mod maps the key to its runtime id.
when state {state:1} is added, remove the boss's stat debuffs, not its bad states; no tag of the game clears debuffs.
